code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Diagnostics

let root = "ls-sample"

IO.Directory.create_directory(root)

for name in ["apple.txt", "banana.txt", "cherry.txt"] do
    IO.File.write_all_text("{root}/{name}", "")
od

let info = ProcessStartInfo("ls", root)
info.redirect_standard_output = true
info.use_shell_execute = false

let process = Process.start(info)!

write_line(process.standard_output.read_to_end().trim())

process.wait_for_exit()

IO.Directory.delete(root, true)
